reason: A is the better proposal because it uses a plausible sub-solidus annealing pathway and tests the corrosion–oxidation trade-off against the metastable baseline, whereas B assumes SPS yields a homogeneous single phase despite its cited Mg–Ti–Zn study reporting multiple phases and proposes 900–1100 °C exposures that may melt or volatilize Mg-/Zn-/Al-rich alloys. A’s claim that Mg-rich segregation improves scale protectiveness remains uncertain and should be resolved by identifying the oxide chemistry and scale continuity.
